dataNotice.title: What the AI receives
dataNotice.body: The AI reads your request and your own charging sessions, payments, reservations and the stations you used. Stored credentials, such as passwords, are never sent. Card numbers and IBANs are cut to their last 4 characters. Email addresses and phone numbers are masked. Charging card and token ids are shortened to their last 4 characters.

dataNotice.title: What the AI provider receives
dataNotice.body: The AI provider never receives stored credentials, such as passwords, API keys, secrets and station passwords. Card numbers and IBANs are cut to their last 4 characters. Support drafts, automatic insights, background workers and driver support also mask email addresses and phone numbers, and hash or shorten driver token ids. The assistant sends driver contact details as stored, only to users allowed to read them. Text you type and text files you attach are checked for keys and card numbers. Images and PDFs you attach are sent as they are.
